name: Starter Sword and Your First Touken Danshi

pages.text: Welcome to the world.$(br2)Your first blade will stand by you through the hardest early days.$(br2)Please choose any one of the five starter swords from your inventory as your starter sword.$(br)Right-click while holding the starter sword to summon your first Touken Danshi!

pages.title: Starter Sword
pages.text: This is your first Touken Danshi.$(br)Your Touken Danshi will remain forever loyal to you. $(br)They can protect your safety and help you with many things.
